fact.en: PV-9 belongs to the same pyrrolidinophenone family as α-PVP, but with a carbon chain three carbons longer.
fact.zh: PV-9 和 α-PVP 同屬吡咯烷苯酮類，但碳鏈長了三個碳。
fact.zhHans: PV-9 和 α-PVP 同属吡咯烷苯酮类，但碳链长了三个碳。
